player_prompt.intro:
Yin aa riäŋ {player_id} në Nim.
Yɔk ee yen lɛ̈ɛ̈ wɛ̈t kuɛr ku bɛn.
Në kɛt yen, lɛ̈ɛ̈ kɛt kɛnɛ kɛn, tɛkɛ wɛ̈t kuɛr kɛnɛ.
Lɔ kɛt '[pile quantity]', kɛt kɛnɛ kɛt ee kɛt kɛnɛ, tɛkɛ wɛ̈t kuɛr ee wɛ̈t kuɛr tɛkɛ.
Në kɛt nhial, '[0 3]' tɛkɛ wɛ̈t kuɛr 3 kɛnɛ kɛt 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: /Thiɛlɛ mi̱ ca jiek kä ta̱a̱ in ci̱ rɔ lot kɛ jɛ. La̱tdɛ kɛɛ '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Riäŋ {player_id}, Cäk kuɛr kekë. Kɛt {col} ee kɛt cɔl.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pile index {pile_index} cɛ wä raar kä min ca mat thi̱n.

observation.removed_from_piles: Raan {player_id} tiop [{pile_index} {quantity}], kadiak {quantity} diaal i ci pile {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Ji̱ ŋarä {player_id} naŋkɛ duɔ̱ɔ̱r in jɔak ((s)!
